manifest.name: POS Safaricom
manifest.summary: Integrate your POS with the Safaricom Payment Provider
manifest.author: Odoo S.A.

models._description: Point of Sale Payment Methods (extended for Safaricom M-Pesa)

views.note: no standalone views; inherited pos_payment_method_views.xml adds Safaricom credential fields to the payment-method form

behavioral_notes.observation: The module makes a pos.payment.method a Safaricom/M-Pesa terminal: _get_payment_terminal_selection adds a ('safaricom','M-Pesa') terminal option, and the till configures Daraja credentials on the method itself -- consumer_key/consumer_secret (Daraja OAuth app), business_short_code (an api.constrains-validated 'shortcode-tillnumber' pair split by _get_business_shortcode/_get_till_number), passkey (used to build the STK password), safaricom_test_mode (sandbox vs api.safaricom.co.ke base-URL switch), and safaricom_payment_type ('mpesa_express' STK push vs 'lipa_na_mpesa' C2B). On create(), a lipa_na_mpesa method auto-calls lipa_na_mpesa_register_urls() to register its C2B validation/confirmation callback URLs with Safaricom. _load_pos_data_fields ships safaricom_test_mode/safaricom_payment_type/business_short_code down to the OWL client. None of this credential/terminal wiring is visible in metadata.

M-Pesa Express tender is a two-step outbound HTTP flow against the Daraja API. _get_bearer_token first does an HTTPBasicAuth GET to the OAuth endpoint (oauth/v1/generate) with the consumer key/secret to obtain a short-lived access_token. mpesa_express_send_payment_request then builds a base64 _get_password(timestamp) = b64(shortcode+passkey+timestamp), formats the customer phone to 254XXXXXXXXX (_format_phone_number), signs a hash_sign payload carrying payment_method_id (expiry 6h) into the CallBackURL, and POSTs the STK-push payload (BusinessShortCode, Password, Timestamp, TransactionType, Amount, PartyA/PartyB, PhoneNumber, CallBackURL, AccountReference) with a Bearer token to the stkpush/v1/processrequest endpoint. On ResponseCode '0' it deliberately returns success=False -- the till is NOT paid yet; it only captured CheckoutRequestID/MerchantRequestID and waits for the asynchronous customer confirmation on their phone. generate_qr_code does an analogous Bearer-token POST to qrcode/v1/generate for a scan-to-pay QR.

Payment confirmation arrives asynchronously from Safaricom on three public, csrf-disabled HTTP routes; each verifies the signed ?payload (verify_hash_signed) to recover the payment_method_id before acting. /pos_safaricom/callback (STK) calls _notify_stk_callback, which parses the stkCallback (ResultCode==0 => success), extracts MpesaReceiptNumber/PhoneNumber from CallbackMetadata, finds every OPEN pos.session whose config uses this method, and pushes a 'SAFARICOM_LATEST_RESPONSE' bus notification to each pos.config so the waiting OWL terminal can complete (or fail) the pos.payment. For Lipa na M-PESA, /c2b/validation/callback accepts the charge and /c2b/confirmation/callback calls _create_payment_transaction, which dedupes on trans_id, creates a transaction.lipa.na.mpesa row, and fires a 'NEW_LIPA_NA_MPESA_TRANSACTION' bus notification; mark_transaction_used later unlinks a matched transaction once the cashier applies it. This bus-driven, server-push completion of the tender is entirely behavioral.

behavioral_notes.element: frontend (OWL POS terminal tender flow) -- gap #3
behavioral_notes.observation: The cashier-facing M-Pesa flow is OWL/JS, not Python: 3 JS files / 1 XML template add a MpesaTransactionPopup component (static/src/app/components/popups/mpesa_transaction_popup.*), a payment_safaricom.js payment-interface, and a patch of PosStore.prototype (static/src/app/services/pos_store.js) into the point_of_sale._assets_pos bundle, plus a test tour. The client triggers the STK push, then listens on the POS bus for the SAFARICOM_LATEST_RESPONSE / NEW_LIPA_NA_MPESA_TRANSACTION notifications emitted by the server callbacks to resolve the in-progress payment line. This screen/popup logic and bus handling is not reverse-engineerable from Python metadata.

The module is an outbound external-payment-provider integration: 4 requests call-sites in models/pos_payment_method.py talk to the Safaricom Daraja API over HTTPS using a consumer key/secret + passkey held on pos.payment.method. Endpoints (sandbox.safaricom.co.ke for test mode, api.safaricom.co.ke for live): oauth/v1/generate (token), mpesa/stkpush/v1/processrequest (STK push), mpesa/c2b/v2/registerurl (C2B URL registration), mpesa/qrcode/v1/generate (pay QR). Inbound, Safaricom POSTs back to three public Odoo callback routes secured only by a hash_sign-signed payload. This third-party network dependency and its credentials are invisible to ORM metadata.

it_architecture.application: pos_safaricom (Safaricom M-Pesa POS payment bridge: extends pos.payment.method into a Daraja/M-Pesa terminal + public callback controller + OWL tender popup)
software_services: /pos_safaricom/callback (public http; M-Pesa Express STK push result callback)
/c2b/validation/callback (public http; Lipa na M-PESA C2B pre-charge validation)
/c2b/confirmation/callback (public http; Lipa na M-PESA C2B payment confirmation)
logical_data_erm: pos.payment.method -> pos.config (config_ids; which tills accept M-Pesa)
pos.payment.method -> pos.payment (tender realized as a POS payment line, base model)
transaction.lipa.na.mpesa (standalone C2B receipt buffer, matched to a tender by trans_id)
information_flows: outbound: pos.payment.method._get_bearer_token -> Safaricom Daraja OAuth (oauth/v1/generate) -> access_token
outbound: mpesa_express_send_payment_request -> Daraja STK Push (stkpush/v1/processrequest) -> CheckoutRequestID (payment pending)
outbound: lipa_na_mpesa_register_urls -> Daraja C2B registerurl; generate_qr_code -> Daraja qrcode/v1/generate
inbound: Safaricom -> /pos_safaricom/callback -> _notify_stk_callback -> pos.config._notify('SAFARICOM_LATEST_RESPONSE') -> OWL terminal completes pos.payment
offline note: tender completion is server-push (bus notifications) because M-Pesa confirmation is asynchronous from the customer's phone

capabilities: Accept M-Pesa Mobile-Money Payment at POS (STK push to customer phone)
Accept Lipa na M-PESA / C2B Till Payment at POS
Configure Safaricom Daraja Credentials per Payment Method (consumer key/secret, shortcode, passkey, sandbox)
Reconcile Asynchronous Mobile-Money Confirmations to the open till tender
value_streams: Collect-mobile-money-at-counter: cashier selects M-Pesa tender -> STK push sent to customer phone (Daraja) -> customer confirms on phone -> Safaricom callback -> bus notification completes pos.payment -> order paid
policies: Lipa na M-PESA methods auto-register C2B callback URLs on create
all public callbacks require a hash_sign-signed, 6h-expiry payload (verify_hash_signed) to identify the payment method
STK push intentionally returns success=False until the asynchronous customer confirmation arrives
C2B transactions deduped by trans_id; consumed transactions unlinked via mark_transaction_used
stakeholders: Customer (confirms STK push / pays via till on their phone)
POS Manager (configures Daraja credentials on the payment method)
Accountant (M-Pesa journal entries via base pos.payment)
metrics: M-Pesa tender amounts roll up via base pos.payment / report.pos.order (no module-specific report)

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services
classification.rationale: pos_safaricom is a thin payment-collection extension of point_of_sale, so it inherits the parent's value-chain primary classification: its act sits inside the retail Sell/Deliver checkout, capturing the customer's tender at the till and completing a pos.payment on the originating pos.order. Mapped to APQC 3.0 (Market and Sell Products and Services) because the operation it adds -- collecting payment for the in-store sale -- is part of selling/closing the counter transaction, mirroring its point_of_sale parent rather than belonging to treasury/AR (APQC 9.0), which is realized downstream by the base POS session closing entry. The module also carries a strong 'network' overtone: it is an outbound integration mediating between the buyer's phone and the Safaricom Daraja mobile-money infrastructure (OAuth + STK push + asynchronous bus-driven confirmation), but the value logic it participates in is the chain sell transaction, so it is classified chain.

standard_capabilities: register M-Pesa as a POS payment terminal (use_payment_terminal = 'safaricom')
M-Pesa Express STK push to the customer's phone from the payment screen
Lipa na M-PESA C2B till payments with auto-registered validation/confirmation callbacks
sandbox (test mode) vs live Daraja environment switch per method
asynchronous confirmation completed via signed public callbacks + POS bus notifications
typical_fits: Kenyan retail / restaurant counters collecting M-Pesa at the till
single Daraja app (consumer key/secret + shortcode/till + passkey) per payment method
multi-till sharing one M-Pesa method via pos.config.payment_method_ids
mixing M-Pesa with cash/card on the same POS order (base pos.payment)
common_gaps: production hardening of the public csrf-disabled callback routes (replay/abuse beyond the signed payload)
no module-specific reconciliation/reporting of transaction.lipa.na.mpesa beyond manual cashier matching
B2B / paybill or reversal/refund flows not covered (STK push + C2B receive only)
dependence on a reachable https web.base.url for callbacks (errors if base url unset / http)
Daraja API/version or fee-structure changes require code edits (endpoints hard-coded)
drive_hints: odoo shell: m = env['pos.payment.method'].search([('use_payment_terminal','=','safaricom')], limit=1); m and m._get_oauth_endpoint()
curl -X POST <base_url>/pos_safaricom/callback (expect ResultCode 1 / ValueError without a valid signed ?payload)
open a POS with the M-Pesa method and trigger the MpesaTransactionPopup on the payment screen

open_questions: Exact OWL handshake: how the payment screen correlates a CheckoutRequestID/MerchantRequestID with the SAFARICOM_LATEST_RESPONSE bus notification to mark the right pos.payment paid.
How a Lipa na M-PESA transaction.lipa.na.mpesa row is matched to an order line by the cashier (amount/number) before mark_transaction_used unlinks it.
Timeout/retry behavior when the customer never confirms the STK push (the tender stays success=False).
Whether/how the M-Pesa receipt number (MpesaReceiptNumber) is persisted on the resulting pos.payment for accounting traceability.
Security posture of the public csrf-disabled callbacks beyond the 6h hash_sign payload (no IP allow-list visible).
